sources.citation: Ramirez, Henri & Maria Cristina Victorino de França. 2019. Línguas Arawak da Bolívia. LIAMES 19: 1-71 (e019012). doi:10.20396/liames.v19i0.8655045. Sec. 9 'O magíana de Ribera', pp. 56-57.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Reproduces the entire corpus of the language -- eight words recorded by Lázaro de Ribera 1786-1792 at Reyes (chimaré 'bom', mononeparé 'mau', nuuʔá 'pai', nuuʔéno 'mãe', nuuʔamí 'irmão', piyochó 'um', tonocovó 'dois', mopoicovó 'três', printed with acute accents) -- and concludes 'Com tão magro material, não se pode concluir nada' (may be a Mojeño dialect, may be another family). No comment on the accent marks or on prosody.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page magi1242 (comment: 'an extinct Bolivia-Parana Arawakan language of Bolivia attested only with the minuscule wordlist in Palau and Saiz 1989 [1794]'; refs Ramirez 2019: 56-57, Hervás 1800: 249).
sources.note: Nothing; confirms the attestation is a minuscule wordlist only.

sources.note: Nothing; no linguistic data at all. States only: 'La lengua majiena ó maxiena se hablaba por una tribu, que estaba el año 1767 en la poblacion de San Francisco de Borja llamada de los Ticomeris. Es desconocido el carácter de la lengua majiena, que no entienden los mojos ni otras naciones que hay en sus poblaciones.'
